text:
Hi Avery,

The tentative October 8 production launch is no longer viable: the security review will complete October 12 at the earliest, and release requires completed approval. The review may also require remediation, so no new production launch date is authorized yet.

We can still hold a staging demo on October 8 using synthetic data. This would be a demo, not a production release.

Nia owns the security review, and we’ll keep the production decision tied to its outcome. Our focus remains on moving forward without compromising the approval requirement.

Please confirm whether you’d like to proceed with the October 8 staging demo.

Best,
Jordan
Engagement Lead
